description: This file defines the 'Stability' class within the 'android::internal' namespace, which manages and encodes the stability levels of Android binder interfaces over time, including methods for downgrading stability, marking stability levels, and checking stability requirements.

classes.name: Stability
classes.description: Manages binder interface stability levels, including downgrades, markings, and stability checks.

methods.name: forceDowngradeToLocalStability
methods.description: Downgrades a binder interface to local stability.

methods.name: forceDowngradeToVendorStability
methods.description: Downgrades a binder interface to vendor stability.

methods.name: forceDowngradeToSystemStability
methods.description: Downgrades a binder interface to system stability.

methods.name: markCompilationUnit
methods.description: Marks a binder as part of a compilation unit; intended for auto-generated code.

methods.name: markVintf
methods.description: Marks a binder as VINTF stable; intended for auto-generated code.

methods.name: debugToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the binder for debugging.

methods.name: markVndk
methods.description: Marks a binder as VNDK; intended for auto-generated code or tests.

methods.name: requiresVintfDeclaration
methods.description: Checks if the binder needs to be declared in the VINTF manifest.
